what_happened: the command succeeded
what_to_do: Nothing.

what_happened: a check file is valid Python but raised an error while it was loaded
what_to_do: Fix the error the message names in that check file, then run the command again.

what_happened: pytest stopped on an error inside pytest or one of the project's plugins
what_to_do: Read the traceback pytest printed, then fix the plugin or conftest.py it names.

what_happened: Python stopped on an error that nothing handled
what_to_do: Read the last lines of the traceback Python printed, then fix the code it names.

what_happened: an aspect's command was given --aspect
what_to_do: Run the command again without --aspect.

what_happened: the argument parser refused the command line
what_to_do: Correct the command line. Run the command with --help to see its options.

group: the working folder is not in the state the command needs
what_happened: the sdg package is not running from inside its repo
what_to_do: Install the package from the repo checkout with pip install -e .

group: the working folder is not in the state the command needs
what_happened: a validation report was refused because the working folder has changes that are not committed
what_to_do: Commit the changes, or set them aside with git stash, then run the report again.

what_happened: .env has no Anthropic API key
what_to_do: Open .env and paste your key after ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=.

what_happened: the .env file has not been created
what_to_do: Create .env from the example with Copy-Item .env.example .env, then fill in its values.

what_happened: .env has no Neo4j connection settings
what_to_do: Copy the NEO4J_ lines from .env.example into .env.

what_happened: the Neo4j address in .env is not a valid address
what_to_do: Make the NEO4J_URI line in .env match .env.example, for example bolt://localhost:7687.

group: an outside program cannot be found
what_happened: git cannot be found on the path
what_to_do: Install git.

group: an outside program cannot be found
what_happened: ruff, mypy or conda cannot be found on the path
what_to_do: Run conda activate sdg, or install conda.

group: an outside program was found but failed to run
what_happened: git was found but did not answer
what_to_do: Run the command from inside the repo's clone, and confirm git works there with git status.

group: an outside program was found but failed to run
what_happened: ruff or mypy was found but did not answer when asked for its version
what_to_do: Confirm the sdg environment holds the tool, or recreate it from environment.yml.

group: an outside program is not the pinned version
what_happened: the running Neo4j is not the version docker-compose.yml pins
what_to_do: Stop whatever answers at that address, then start the pinned container from the repo folder with docker compose up -d.

group: an outside program is not the pinned version
what_happened: the fingerprints in the validation inventory were made by another Python version
what_to_do: Run build_inventory --python-changed, and commit the result alone, in a commit that changes nothing else.

what_happened: the Claude API could not be reached
what_to_do: Confirm the network connection works, then run the command again.

what_happened: ClinicalTrials.gov could not be reached or did not answer in time
what_to_do: Confirm the network connection works, then run the command again.

what_happened: a download's server could not be reached, did not answer in time, or stopped part way
what_to_do: Confirm the network connection works, then run acquire_sources again.

what_happened: Neo4j could not be reached at the address in .env
what_to_do: Start the container from the repo folder with docker compose up -d.

group: a service refused the login, key or permission
what_happened: the Claude API knows the key but refused it access to the model
what_to_do: The key is right. Look at the account it belongs to at https://console.anthropic.com/.

group: a service refused the login, key or permission
what_happened: the Claude API rejected the key
what_to_do: Confirm the key at https://console.anthropic.com/ and paste it into .env again.

group: a service refused the login, key or permission
what_happened: a download's server refused access to the file
what_to_do: Confirm the url in the manifest still gives public access to the file.

group: a service refused the login, key or permission
what_happened: Neo4j rejected the login in .env
what_to_do: Make NEO4J_USER and NEO4J_PASSWORD in .env match the NEO4J_AUTH line in docker-compose.yml.

group: a service answered with an error
what_happened: the Claude API answered with an error
what_to_do: Act on the API's own message, which the command prints.

group: a service answered with an error
what_happened: ClinicalTrials.gov answered with an error
what_to_do: Act on the message the command prints. A rejected search usually means the query in src/sdg/sources/ctgov_study_filters.yml needs correcting.

group: a service answered with an error
what_happened: a download's server answered with an error
what_to_do: Confirm the url in the manifest still serves the file. A file that moved is a deliberate re-pin.

what_happened: pyproject.toml installs a command from a file that does not exist
what_to_do: Correct the entry in pyproject.toml, or restore the file from git.

what_happened: docs/commands.md is missing
what_to_do: Run build_index.

what_happened: docker-compose.yml is missing
what_to_do: Restore docker-compose.yml from git.

what_happened: docs/exit_codes.csv is missing
what_to_do: Restore docs/exit_codes.csv from git.

what_happened: the ClinicalTrials.gov filters file is missing
what_to_do: Restore src/sdg/sources/ctgov_study_filters.yml from git.

what_happened: validation/validation_groups.yml, which --group reads, is missing
what_to_do: Restore validation/validation_groups.yml from git, or run without --group.

what_happened: validation/validation_inventory.csv is missing
what_to_do: Run build_inventory.

what_happened: the list of lookup documents is missing
what_to_do: Restore src/sdg/view/lookup_documents.yml from git.

what_happened: the manifests folder is missing or holds no manifest
what_to_do: Restore manifests/ from git with git checkout.

what_happened: a pinned file has not been downloaded
what_to_do: Run acquire_sources.

what_happened: pyproject.toml is missing
what_to_do: Restore pyproject.toml from git.

what_happened: docs/sources_index.md is missing
what_to_do: Restore docs/sources_index.md from git.

what_happened: the validation/ folder is missing
what_to_do: Restore validation/ from git.

group: a file exists but cannot be opened
what_happened: docs/exit_codes.csv cannot be opened
what_to_do: Close any program holding the file, then run the command again.

group: a file exists but cannot be opened
what_happened: the ClinicalTrials.gov filters file is on disk but cannot be opened
what_to_do: Close any program holding the file, then run the command again.

group: a file exists but cannot be opened
what_happened: the list of lookup documents is on disk but cannot be opened
what_to_do: Close any program holding the file, then run the command again.

group: a file exists but cannot be opened
what_happened: a manifest is on disk but cannot be opened
what_to_do: Close any program holding the file, or restore manifests/ from git.

group: a file exists but cannot be opened
what_happened: a pinned file is on disk but cannot be opened
what_to_do: Close the program holding the file, or remove what sits where the file should be, then run the command again.

group: a file exists but cannot be opened
what_happened: pyproject.toml cannot be opened
what_to_do: Close any program holding the file, then run the command again.

group: a file exists but cannot be opened
what_happened: a Python file cannot be opened
what_to_do: Close any program holding the file, then run the command again.

group: a file exists but cannot be opened
what_happened: docs/sources_index.md cannot be opened
what_to_do: Close any program holding the file, then run the command again.

what_happened: docker-compose.yml is not valid YAML
what_to_do: Restore docker-compose.yml from git.

what_happened: the answer from ClinicalTrials.gov is not valid JSON
what_to_do: Run the command again. If it keeps failing, ClinicalTrials.gov may be changing its service.

what_happened: the ClinicalTrials.gov filters file is not valid YAML
what_to_do: Correct the YAML the message names, or restore src/sdg/sources/ctgov_study_filters.yml from git.

what_happened: the list of lookup documents is not valid YAML
what_to_do: Correct the YAML the message names, or restore the file from git.

what_happened: a manifest is not valid JSON
what_to_do: Restore manifests/ from git with git checkout.

what_happened: a pinned file a measurement reads is not valid in its format
what_to_do: Remove the file and run acquire_sources, which fetches the pinned copy again.

what_happened: pyproject.toml is not valid TOML
what_to_do: Correct the TOML the message names, or restore pyproject.toml from git.

what_happened: a Python file is not saved as UTF-8 text
what_to_do: Save the file as UTF-8 text.

what_happened: a Python file is not valid Python
what_to_do: Fix the syntax error the message names.

what_happened: the pinned model file is not valid YAML
what_to_do: Remove the file and run acquire_sources, which fetches the pinned copy again.

what_happened: a check file is in a code folder the inventory has no place for
what_to_do: Move the check file to the folder that mirrors its target, or add the folder to CODE_FOLDER_ORDER in src/sdgval/build_inventory.py.

what_happened: a check file's name has no aspect of quality, or it holds a check of another aspect
what_to_do: Name the check file with its aspect, as test_<file>_<aspect>.py, and keep only checks of that aspect in it.

what_happened: a check is not written as a function at the top level of its check file
what_to_do: Move the check out of its class, to the top level of its check file.

what_happened: a check's markers, id or first sentence are missing or wrong, or its id is a duplicate
what_to_do: Correct the marker, id or first sentence the message names.

what_happened: docker-compose.yml names no Neo4j image in the form neo4j:<version>-<edition>
what_to_do: Write the image line as, for example, neo4j:5.26.29-community.

what_happened: a row of docs/exit_codes.csv breaks the table's rules
what_to_do: Correct the row the message names in docs/exit_codes.csv.

what_happened: the ClinicalTrials.gov filters file is missing a setting the script needs, or has a filter the script does not apply
what_to_do: Correct the setting the message names in src/sdg/sources/ctgov_study_filters.yml, or restore the file from git.

what_happened: a check's fingerprint in the validation inventory is missing or unreadable
what_to_do: Put the check's fingerprint back as git last recorded it, then run build_inventory again.

what_happened: a group in validation/validation_groups.yml lists no ids
what_to_do: Give the group an ids list naming at least one check.

what_happened: a group in validation/validation_groups.yml lists checks of more than one aspect
what_to_do: Keep the group to checks of one aspect.

what_happened: a header block is incomplete, out of order, has a bad Date, or lists no exit code though the file has a main()
what_to_do: Complete the header block as .claude/rules/writing_python_files.md describes it.

what_happened: a Python file has no header block
what_to_do: Add the header block .claude/rules/writing_python_files.md describes.

what_happened: a hand-kept column of the validation inventory breaks its rules
what_to_do: Correct the hand-kept column the message names in validation/validation_inventory.csv.

what_happened: the list of lookup documents breaks a requirement
what_to_do: Correct the entry the message names in src/sdg/view/lookup_documents.yml.

what_happened: a manifest's content breaks a requirement
what_to_do: Repair the entry the message names, or restore manifests/ from git.

what_happened: a manifest records a location that does not stay under inputs/
what_to_do: Write the entry's local as a path under inputs/, with no .., drive or leading slash.

what_happened: two manifest entries record the same file name
what_to_do: Change the code that asks for the name so it chooses one version of the file.

what_happened: a manifest entry's url is not one the download library can use
what_to_do: Correct the url in the manifest entry.

what_happened: a pinned file is not shaped the way a measurement expects
what_to_do: Look at the file the message names. A publisher change to its layout needs the measurement in src/sdgtools/check_facts.py updated.

what_happened: the [project.scripts] table of pyproject.toml does not name each command with the module and function it runs
what_to_do: Write each [project.scripts] entry as the module and function it runs, as in sdg.sources.acquire_sources:main.

what_happened: ruff or mypy reported a problem in a Python file
what_to_do: Fix what ruff or mypy reported, above the verdict lines.

what_happened: the pinned model file is not shaped like the pinned USDM model
what_to_do: Look at the class the message names. A new USDM layout is a deliberate re-pin.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a check's code changed but its version in the validation inventory did not
what_to_do: Raise the check's version in validation/validation_inventory.csv, then run build_inventory again.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: pyproject.toml installs a command from a package that has no heading on the page
what_to_do: Add the package to COMMAND_GROUPS in src/sdgtools/build_index.py.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: docs/commands.md does not match the commands' headers
what_to_do: Run build_index.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a downloaded file does not match its manifest entry
what_to_do: The publisher may have changed the file. Compare the two, and re-pin deliberately if it is a new version.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a group in docs/exit_codes.csv is worded differently from src/sdg/exit_codes.py
what_to_do: Word the group the same way in docs/exit_codes.csv and in GROUPS in src/sdg/exit_codes.py.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a stated figure has drifted from the pinned files
what_to_do: Correct the figure in the document the message names.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a recorded figure is stated in no document
what_to_do: State the figure again where the project reasons from it, or remove its measurement from FACTS in src/sdgtools/check_facts.py.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a file under inputs/ is recorded by no manifest
what_to_do: Record the file in manifests/, or remove it from inputs/.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a group in validation/validation_groups.yml lists an id no check has
what_to_do: Remove the id from the group, or correct it to a check's id.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a header does not list an exit code or sub-code its file uses
what_to_do: Add the exit number and sub-code to the header's Exit codes field.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a header's Exit codes field disagrees with docs/exit_codes.csv
what_to_do: Word the header's entry the way docs/exit_codes.csv words the sub-code, with the same exit number.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a row of the validation inventory disagrees with the check files
what_to_do: Mark the row retired or superseded, put the check back, or give a new check the next free id, as the message says.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: validation/validation_inventory.csv is stale
what_to_do: Run build_inventory.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: the list of lookup documents names a file no manifest records
what_to_do: Correct the name in src/sdg/view/lookup_documents.yml, or record the file in manifests/.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a pinned file on disk no longer matches its manifest entry
what_to_do: Remove the file and run acquire_sources if it changed by accident. A real new version is a deliberate re-pin.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: a pinned file has no document heading in the sources map
what_to_do: Add a document heading for the file to docs/sources_index.md.

group: a description does not match the thing it describes
what_happened: the sources map names a location no manifest records
what_to_do: Correct the location in docs/sources_index.md, or record a file there in manifests/.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: no study on ClinicalTrials.gov passed every filter
what_to_do: Read the search record in searches/ctgov/ to see which filter removed the last studies, then loosen it in src/sdg/sources/ctgov_study_filters.yml.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: the named header row is past the end of the sheet
what_to_do: Run without --header-row to see the sheet, then name a row it has.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: no manifest has the name given
what_to_do: Name a manifest that exists in manifests/.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: a section was asked for in a PDF that has no bookmarks
what_to_do: Use --find to search the document, or --pages to read a known range.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: no section in the PDF matches the one asked for
what_to_do: Run with --list to see the sections, then ask for one of them.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: the selection options leave no check to run
what_to_do: Widen or drop the selection options, as the message says.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: the named sheet does not exist in the workbook
what_to_do: Run without --sheet to list the sheets, then name one of them.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: the class named is not in the model
what_to_do: Run usdm_spec --list-classes to see the classes, then name one of them.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: the name given matches more than one workbook under inputs/
what_to_do: Give more of the name, so it matches one of the workbooks listed.

group: the parameters given yielded no results
what_happened: no workbook under inputs/ matches the name given
what_to_do: Run read_xlsx with no name to list the workbooks, then name one of them.

group: the command found no target to act on
what_happened: no check files were found under validation/
what_to_do: Add a check file under validation/, or restore the check files from git.

group: the command found no target to act on
what_happened: no check was collected
what_to_do: Point the run at a folder or file that holds checks.

group: the command found no target to act on
what_happened: pyproject.toml installs no command
what_to_do: Add the commands to the [project.scripts] table of pyproject.toml.

group: an output already exists and is not overwritten
what_happened: no command fails this way yet

group: an output could not be written
what_happened: the ClinicalTrials.gov search record, or its folder, could not be written to disk
what_to_do: Free space on the disk, or remove what sits where searches/ctgov/ or the file should be, then run the command again.

group: an output could not be written
what_happened: a download, or its folder, could not be written to disk
what_to_do: Free space on the disk, or remove what sits where the file or its folder should be, then run acquire_sources again.

group: one or more validation checks failed
what_happened: one or more validation checks failed
what_to_do: Read the failed checks pytest listed, then fix what each names.

group: an evaluation score fell below its threshold
what_happened: no command fails this way yet

group: the run was interrupted before it finished
what_happened: the check run was interrupted before every check ran
what_to_do: Run the command again, and let it finish.

what_happened: two or more files import each other, directly or through other files
what_to_do: Move what both files need into a file of its own, which each can import.
